feedback.problem: What is the value of $f(t)=⟨3{e}^{t-5},\,\sqrt{t+4},\,(t-3)^{4}⟩$ at $t=5?$
feedback.worked_solution:
To evaluate, we substitute $t=5$ into the function, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}f(5) & =⟨3{e}^{5-5},\sqrt{5+4},(5-3)^{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨3{e}^{0},\sqrt{9},{2}^{4}⟩ \\  & =⟨3,3,16⟩\end{aligned}
$$

So, the value of $f(t)$ at $t=5$ is the vector $⟨3,3,16⟩.$
